title: Living Wiki + Graph phase 5: freshness as a health metric and a CI signal

AC1.note: wiki-freshness-gate.test.ts 'a report written before this field existed renders unchanged apart from the new section'; field is optional on HealthReport, added exactly as hotspots was

AC2.note: wiki-freshness.test.ts 'reports the counts and a ratio over SCORABLE pages'; live artifact shows 'wiki freshness: 77% (34/44 scorable pages, 6 undecidable (excluded)), 2 needing attention'

AC3.note: wiki-freshness.test.ts 'no report yields no number and says why' — ratio and pagesFresh both undefined, reason contains 'not evidence that the wiki is fresh'; artifact renders 'Not measured'

AC4.note: Denominator is pagesTotal minus pagesUndecidable (34/44 not 34/50) and the excluded count is in the rendered line; asserted in two tests

AC5.note: wiki-freshness.test.ts 'an old report keeps its numbers but is marked as not current' — status stale-evidence, reportAgeDays 34, line contains STALE EVIDENCE

AC6.note: wiki-freshness.test.ts unparseable JSON and missing-totals cases both yield unreadable-report with no partial number

AC7.note: Compile-time guard: Parameters<typeof computeGate>[0] has no wikiFreshness key, so the metric structurally cannot reach the gate; the type fails to compile if anyone adds it. Plus a rendered gate-line comparison with a catastrophic 2/44 figure

AC8.note: wiki-freshness.test.ts 'works with no graph and no wiki present at all' (asserts .metaproject contains only data/) and 'a wiki full of pages does not change the numbers'

AC9.note: .github/workflows/wiki-freshness.yml: validate is a gate, freshness reports and never fails, summary calls empty findings clean only when limitations is empty. YAML parsed, summary logic exercised on clean / empty+limits / findings

AC10.note: Full suite 6776 pass / 48 fail — the same 48 that fail at the branch base

tasks.dispositionReason: Self-review replaced a vacuous AC8 test that asserted an always-empty array with one that proves the point: the metric resolves in a project with no graph and no wiki, and a wiki full of pages does not change its numbers

tasks.dispositionReason: readWikiFreshnessMetric: no-report, unreadable-report and stale-evidence all reported with a reason and never a number (AC3,AC5,AC6)

tasks.title: Ratio excluding undecidable pages, with the count alongside (AC2,AC4)
tasks.dispositionReason: Ratio over scorable pages only, with the undecidable count rendered alongside so the figure cannot hide what it excludes (AC2,AC4)

tasks.title: Render in the health artifact and dashboard line (AC2)
tasks.dispositionReason: Rendered in the health artifact as its own section; absence gets a sentence rather than silence. Live run shows 77% (34/44), 6 excluded, 2 needing attention (AC2)

tasks.title: CI workflow per ci-protocol.md section 6 (AC9)
tasks.dispositionReason: .github/workflows/wiki-freshness.yml per ci-protocol section 6: validate blocking, freshness reporting, summary calls empty findings clean only when limitations is empty too. YAML parse-checked; summary logic exercised on all three cases (AC9)

tasks.dispositionReason: 21 tests across two files incl. the compile-time guard that computeGate's input cannot carry the metric (AC7,AC8,AC10)
